messages:
jessica_p: Heads-up — ClearNorth SI integration in staging is failing when we pull the marketplace image into their private VPC. Error looks like a TLS/connection drop. Need a quick architecture check and to escalate to partners if certs/registry issues.

mike_devex: Can you paste the error snippet and the image tag?

jessica_p: Sure, snippet from the k8s pod logs:
```
ERROR: ssl_read: connection reset by peer
grpc: failed to create client: dial tcp 10.12.3.4:443: connect: connection refused
failed to pull image "marketplace.redwood/cloud-inference:r1.2-market"
```

sarah_se: Is this the marketplace-signed image (r1.2-market)? If the customer is behind NAT/firewall we often see the TLS broken by intermediate proxies. Also check image digest vs marketplace manifest.

anand_partner: We pushed r1.2-market yesterday with the new signing key. Tag -> digest is sha256:9f8a... I'll validate the manifest now. Not oncall but can dig in.

tim_ops: Oncall checked preliminary network logs — looks like staging's egress ACL is dropping connections to our registry IP range. Running a quick check: `curl -v https://registry.marketplace.redwood/health` from their node times out.

oncall_bot: INC-2026-238 created: "ClearNorth staging: marketplace image pull failures (private VPC)" — assigned to ops and partnerships.

luis_si: Customer reports their perimeter firewall will only allow TLS to a whitelist of FQDNs and blocks direct IP egress. Marketplace registry resolves to a pool that sometimes returns 3rd-party CDN IPs. Might be the cause.

harry_ce: I can run a short architecture review with the SI and ClearNorth infra team. 30-min sync in ~15? I sent a calendar invite to the thread. Please add any reproducer steps to the ticket before the call.

jessica_p: Added reproducer steps + the `kubectl describe pod` output and the docker inspect of the image pull:
```
Image: marketplace.redwood/cloud-inference:r1.2-market
Digest: sha256:9f8a...
Error: Get "https://registry.marketplace.redwood/v2/": net/http: TLS handshake timeout
```

mike_devex: If we need a hot workaround, we can provide a fallback image hosted on the customer's allowed registry or push to their private blob store. I'll draft a rollback/playbook (pin to r1.1 which we know works).

sarah_se: Note: r1.1 has slightly different tokenizer preprocessing — rolling back may change outputs. We'll run a quick eval check post-rollback to validate no critical regressions.

anand_partner: I'll verify the signing cert chain for r1.2-market. If the cert chain includes a CA not trusted by the customer's appliance, re-signing with an alternate intermediate may be required. Standby.

tim_ops: Filed an infra change request to add the registry FQDN to the staging egress allowlist (CHG-7842). ETA ~2 hours for approval in their change window. If they can't wait, we go fallback approach.

jessica_p: Action items captured in INC-2026-238: 1) partner validates cert chain (anand) 2) ops tests registry reachability & change request (tim) 3) engineering readies rollback playbook (mike) 4) SE runs quick eval after rollback (sarah).

mike_devex: I'll post the rollback runbook here in the next 20m and a quick `kubectl` one-liner to pin the deployment.

sarah_se: Also add a note to run the Redwood eval harness on the staging prompt set to detect changes. Won't take long.

anand_partner: Confirmed manifest shows cert chain with intermediate CA X that some older firewalls drop. I can prepare a re-signed manifest and push an alternate tag if needed — will coordinate with mike for distribution options.

harry_ce: Good. If partners push an alternate image, prefer customer's private registry or return a single-hostname CDN so firewall whitelists work. We'll document marketplace IP ranges and FQDNs in the SI runbook.

jessica_p: Thanks all. Syncing into the call now. Will update this thread with outcome and next steps. :thumbsup:
